verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's own app listing documents photo upload for interpretation: you can snap or upload a picture to transcribe a handwritten recipe or get info about a landmark. That covers the core of sharing images and having them understood. Evidence is limited to that marketing-level description. missing for 10: explicit documentation of user-shared screenshot interpretation, in-depth first-party docs on image understanding, independent or hands-on corroboration of interpretation accuracy.
